summary.title: Summaries
summary.autoContinueDescription: Continue drafts that reached the output limit before the next completion. Cancelled drafts and drafts put aside with Later stay paused.
summary.historyDescription: Uses plain conversation text through the second-latest character response. Images and other data sources are excluded. Local summarization temporarily replaces the model’s active context; saved chat KV files are preserved.
summary.disabled: Enable summaries in Data Sources to generate and use them.
summary.paused: Automatic summaries are paused until this draft is resolved.
summary.sourceChanged: Source history changed. Save to keep this summary, or regenerate it.
summary.tasks.running.title: Generating title
summary.tasks.cancelling.title: Cancelling title
summary.tasks.pending.title: Title queued
summary.noStats: No prompt has been built yet.
summary.deleteConfirm: Delete this summary? The original chat history is retained.
summary.minimumHistoryDescription: 最少源历史 token 数，占预留回复 token 后提示词容量的百分比。如果允许的历史范围不足，自动摘要将等待。
summary.maximumCoverageDescription: 最多概括当前上下文中未摘要历史的这一比例，保留较新的完整对话。
summary.consolidateDescription: 当旧摘要占据大部分上下文且符合条件的原始历史不足时，合并旧摘要。重复压缩可能丢失细节。
summary.compressionFallback: 此草稿处理完毕前，回复会使用已接受的摘要和仍能放入上下文的历史。
